as_of_content:
'''Shock''' is a [[Damaging Debuff|damaging debuff]] ability which deals Shock damage over time.

Not to be confused with Instant Shock damage.

== Characteristics ==
Shock damage is characterized as a Bot being shocked with some kind of electricity charge.

== Strategies ==
Some [[Brawler]] Bots work around [[Bleed]]s to gain ground, but some don't work around Shocks. Use this to your advantage to take down tough Brawlers.

== Bots that inflict Shock damage ==
* [[Thundercracker]] (Special 3)
* [[Scorponok]] (3 or more Venom Backfires expire)
* [[Bumblebee]] (Shield Break)
*[[Kickback]] (Special 1)
*[[Windblade]] (Special 1)
*[[Jetfire]] (Heavy & Special 3)
*[[Wheeljack]] (Special Attacks)
*[[Blaster]] (Heavy)
*[[Shockwave]] (Heavy, Special 1 & 3)
*[[Soundwave]] (Heavy, Special 2 & 3)
*[[Ratchet]] (Ranged Attacks)
*[[Rhinox]] (From his "Overclock" signature)
*[[Megatron]] (Special 3)
*[[Bumblebee (DOTM)]] - (Special 2 & 3)
